method.advance: For each added duration and cutoff, require at least as many useful locations as the paired six-second arm overall, at least one useful location from each source, and no more than one extra ordinary control flag overall relative to six seconds. Whole-recording low-pass must never flag. Useful means 0.30 IoU and half edit coverage.
method.controls: Untouched, global low-pass, local gain, and a local ordinary cut from the next twelve seconds. Two local low-pass cutoffs are 3400 and 3800 Hz. Use 25 ms cosine edges and choose the exact edit from the unmodified twelve-second PCM hash.
method.duration: Six and eight seconds are exact nested slices within twelve seconds. Start the six-second crop at +3 seconds and the eight at +2; preserve one recording and one intervention.
method.point: Keep the same 16 dB point and compare every planned native sample range. No recentering or re-fit.
method.sources: Sixteen clips per retained AMI file, chosen by digest from 24-second grid positions in equal strata at least 24 seconds from the file edges. Reuse neither prior bandwidth meeting. Read channel one without mixing.
